description: Incubation and generation-interval distributions for sentinel attribution. Hours, not epochs: the epoch grid is a property of the run, not of the pathogen. measles is carried as the documented counter-example for the port-resolution criterion (spec 1.8), not as a supported sentinel pathogen.
incubation_source_of_truth: For any entry carrying pathogen_id, the incubation block is a projection of that pathogen profile's incubation block in data/pathogens/active_profiles.json: median_hours = median_days * 24, sigma = log(dispersion) (the profile's dispersion is a geometric standard deviation), min_hours/max_hours = min_days/max_days * 24. Do not edit those fields here; edit the profile and re-project. picard_framework/analysis/sentinel/profile_delays.py performs the projection and tests/test_sentinel_profile_delays.py fails on drift. Generation and shedding kernels have no profile counterpart and remain sentinel-side literature values. The projection is the kernel of a host at the profile's dose reference: the profile conditions each draw on dose and this pathogen-level kernel cannot (docs/incubation_reconciliation_plan.md, R2).

wastewater.source: Greywater holding/residence time between a shedding event and the collection point. A ship's greywater is a closed integrating system, so the signal lags incidence and then persists (spec 1.3). max_effective_reads caps the depth one pooled sample is allowed to claim: replicate reads out of one holding tank are not independent trials.

incubation.source: Projected from the norwalk_gi profile (median 1.2 d, GSD 1.56, 0.1-6 d): Lee et al. 2013 pooled norovirus GII via docs/ctb_incubation_spec.md. Discretized IQR is ~17 h, inside the shortest cruise inter-port interval, so ports stay separable (spec 1.8).

generation.source: Household/closed-setting serial intervals, ~1.5-2 d. Sentinel-side: the pathogen profile states no generation interval, and an incubation period is not one.

shedding.source: Faecal shedding duration, ~1-3 weeks post-infection and longer in a minority. Used as a survival kernel (P(still shedding at lag k)), not as a delay pmf: wastewater observes prevalence of shedders, not onsets.

incubation.source: Projected from the sars_cov2_resp profile (median 5.8 d, GSD 1.57, 0.5-21 d): Wei et al. 2021 ancestral lineage via docs/ctb_incubation_spec.md. Discretized IQR is ~86 h, far past any cruise inter-port interval, so a single onset attributes to a port window set rather than a port (spec 1.8). Later lineages incubate faster; change median_days on the profile per scenario, not this file.

generation.source: Ancestral-lineage generation interval ~5 d. Sentinel-side literature value, uncalibrated against this simulator's onboard secondaries; it sets the renewal term, so a paper quoting onboard R should refit it.

shedding.source: Respiratory RNA positivity ~1-2 weeks, long tail. As for norovirus this is a survival kernel, and it is the weakest-anchored number in this entry: wastewater deconvolution weights depend on it.

incubation.source: 10-14 d incubation. IQR far exceeds any cruise inter-port interval, so ports are not separable (spec 1.8). No pathogen_id: the simulator does not model measles, so this entry is sentinel-side only and is not drift-checked.

shedding.source: Respiratory shedding window; carried only so the counter-example pathogen has a complete entry, not because measles wastewater surveillance is supported.
